title: MCP tool fpv_preflight, read-only
goal: NERV and any MCP client can ask FPVBuddy for the pre-flight assessment
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the pre-flight check plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok" and "real" data).

The F-009-T02 server exposes fpv_preflight, annotated read-only (it never changes data) and taking no required arguments (an optional date); its description and every field carry the Italian and English text fixed in F-024-T01

Specs cover the tool over the server's own test client: the read-only annotation, the Italian and the English description, an empty fleet and a fleet with one item of each verdict; an unknown argument is refused
privacy: Invented data only (neutral drone, battery and spare names); no owner data, secrets or export files in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one tool on the server pattern of F-009-T02 over the F-024-T02 function. Not a measurement.
